office_does: The auditor runs Klickitat County's elections and handles the office's recording, licensing and accounting work.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Heather Jobe (Prefers Republican Party), elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Klickitat County Auditor, elected in 2022 after six years as chief deputy auditor; the only candidate.
highlights: Chief deputy auditor for six years before that [S1]
Cites election security and transparency work [S1]
